correctness.rationale: The all-positive shattering trace translates a hypothetical five-point sample into weight <=2 vectors, so their support has <=10 coordinates. Outside-support center bits give effective radii 2,1,0 or the empty trace; padding to ten coordinates yields an exact overapproximation. Independent exhaustive bitset trace-refinement, with 56 candidate points and all 3072 radius-center concepts, counted 1540,27720,49830,0 shattered 2-,3-,4-,5-sets. The zero at five plus support reduction proves the bound for every d; an independent anchored 4-cube exhaustive obstruction and explicit 3-point/4-point witnesses handle d=4,5; dimensions <=3 are immediate. Finite exhaustive lemma is a proved bounded kernel, not a small-dimension extrapolation.
